newsitem.title: UK: UK coffee party to honour Asian growers.
newsitem.headline: UK coffee party to honour Asian growers.

text.p: Some 1,100 coffee traders, consumers and growers will gather in London this Friday for the annual UK coffee trade dinner, the organisers said on Wednesday.
Anthony Miller, chairman of the UK Coffee Federation, said this year's gathering would spotlight the fast-growing Asian coffee exporters -- Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam.
"Some 1,100 people from the world of coffee will be present and this year we will recognise the importance of the Far East producing countries," he told Reuters. He gave no details.
Indonesia is Asia's major coffee grower and the world's top producer of the robusta variety.
